title: Band captain, and band plus school orchestra
summary: He gets into the band within a month, becomes captain after Allen graduates, and keeps playing violin in the orchestra.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How long did it take you to get into the band?
Well, I don't know. I'd say about a month.
Uh-huh. Were you in the band all through high school?

All through high school. In fact, after the first semester, Charlie Allen was graduated. He was a 2nd Lieutenant. The 1st Lieutenant, the doctor took him off his instrument, on account of his health, and the captain graduated. And I wound up being captain of the band in one semester.
The captain in the ROTC? You had the uniform and everything like that?
Why did you want to get into the ROTC?
Well, it wasn't exactly the ROTC there, I just wanted to get into the band. I just wanted some instrument beside the violin.
Were you tired of the violin by then?
I wasn't tired of it, because I was still playing violin in the orchestra, school orchestra.
You were in both the band and the orchestra?
Yeah, band and the orchestra. Yeah.
